Dear Nidhu,

On this little day dedicated to saying “I love you,” I hope you hear something important: you are worthy of care, respect, laughter, and the kind of happiness that doesn't ask you to become someone else.

Keep choosing your dreams. Keep discovering new places, new possibilities, and new versions of yourself. I hope life surprises you with good people, beautiful opportunities, peaceful days, and reasons to smile when you least expect them.

And on the days when everything feels uncertain, please be gentle with yourself. You are still becoming—and that is a beautiful thing.

With warmth, always ♡
One last little wish
♥

May you always feel loved, valued, and free to be yourself.

Happy “I Love You” Day, Nidhu. May today bring you a soft smile, a peaceful heart, and one more reason to believe in the beautiful things still ahead. ♡

Written for today's special day

The letter I wanted
you to read, Nidhu.

A memory from the beginning, a truth about today, and a wish for every chapter still to come.

✉♥

Dear Nidhu,

I still remember the first time I saw you at Sutherland. We were waiting in the waiting lounge, and I noticed you. My first thought was that you looked so beautiful—and at the same time, you seemed to have so much attitude! 😂 I honestly wondered, “How could someone like her ever become my girlfriend?” Back then, I never imagined how our story would turn out.

Look at us now. With Mahadev's blessings, someone I first noticed as a beautiful girl has become a very, very close friend and, in my heart, my best sister. Life gave our connection a different shape from what I once imagined—and today, I can genuinely smile about that.

Nidhu, I am happy that I got you in my life—not as my girlfriend, but as a beautiful sister. ❤️ Our bond is pavitra to me, and I want it to be filled with respect, laughter, honest friendship, prayers, and care that never asks you to be anything other than yourself.

My wish for you is bigger than this little website. I want you to grow into the life you dream about. I want your career to move forward, your Mumbai chapter to become a beautiful memory in the making, and your heart to feel peaceful. I hope you meet good people, discover places that make you feel alive, and keep finding reasons to believe in yourself.

And my promise is simple: I will keep wishing the best for you, respect your choices, cheer for your wins, and hope you are safe and happy. I know that caring for someone also means giving them room to grow, make their own decisions, and follow their own journey. That is the kind of brother I want to be.

Thank you for becoming a part of my life in a way I never expected. From that waiting lounge at Sutherland to the bond we share today, I am grateful for the unexpected turns that brought us here.

May Mahadev always protect you, guide you, bless your dreams, and keep your smile safe. Wherever life takes you, I hope you never forget how much goodness you deserve.

Happy “I Love You” Day, Nidhu. I love you in the way a brother loves his sister—with prayers, protection, respect, and a heart that wants to see her happy. Our pavitra rishta will always be a special chapter in my story. 🔱🤍
With lots of care, your brother ♡
